description: This file defines the main Backbone.js view for a TodoMVC application, managing the top-level UI interactions, rendering, and event handling for the todo list.

classes.name: app.AppView
classes.description: A Backbone View that manages the main TodoMVC application interface, handling rendering, user interactions, and collection events.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up event listeners on the todos collection, initializes DOM element references, and fetches existing todos.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Updates the UI to reflect the current state of the todos collection, showing or hiding elements and updating statistics.

methods.name: addOne
methods.description: Creates and appends a view for a single todo item.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description: Adds all todo items to the list view.

methods.name: filterOne
methods.description: Triggers visibility update for a single todo item.

methods.name: filterAll
methods.description: Applies filtering to all todo items.

methods.name: newAttributes
methods.description: Generates attributes for a new todo item based on user input.

methods.name: createOnEnter
methods.description: Creates a new todo item when the Enter key is pressed in the input field.

methods.name: toggleAllComplete
methods.description: Sets all todo items as completed or not based on the toggle checkbox.
